errors.SESSION_NOT_FOUND: This session no longer exists. It may have been deleted.

errors.SESSION_TYPE_NOT_FOUND: That session type no longer exists. Pick another one.

errors.SETTING_TYPE_MISMATCH: A setting couldn't be read. Restart the app.

errors.SUBMISSION_DIRECTION_INVALID: A submission must be landed or taken.
errors.TAXONOMY_ROW_NOT_FOUND: This entry is no longer in the library.
errors.TECHNIQUE_NOT_FOUND: One of the techniques is no longer in the library. Remove it and save again.
errors.TECHNIQUE_REQUIRES_ACTUAL: Techniques can only be attached to a focus you trained. Tick it as trained first.
